positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Updated and wrote unit tests for an Angular application using Spectator, improving code reliability and maintainability.
Migrated AWS Lambda functions to a Flask API, enhancing system scalability and performance.
Communicated with clients weekly to identify potential bugs and implement software improvements, ensuring alignment with user requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Unit Testing · Machine Learning · Computer Science · Flask

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced a simulation framework for training AI agents using the Composabl platform, optimizing its performance and adaptability.
Developed Python-based Jupyter notebooks for efficient data gathering and interpolation, supporting complex data analysis and modeling.
Refined an internal AI demonstration project, tailoring it to effectively showcase RoviSys’s AI capabilities to prospective clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning · Computer Engineering · Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Composabl · Computer Science

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Conducted independent testing on a POS system using the Postman API to send JSON requests.
Implemented dependency injection to decouple processes, and created over 100 unit tests in xUnit afterward.
Gained extensive experience in full-stack development with Angular JS, which enhanced my proficiency in the Entity Framework, component architecture, and state management.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · AngularJS · .NET Framework · Dependency Injection · Postman API · Unit Testing · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · xUnit

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated on a WPF application, adding new screens and serialized messages.
Added new data fields to a website coded in Angular JS, involving modifying a code-first SQL database and understanding entity framework.
Leveraged python and pandas for AI data analysis, primarily to determine if the data could be interfaced with an AI model.
positions.insights: Skills: Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · Software Development · SQL · AngularJS · HTML · .NET Framework · Dependency Injection · Postman API · Data Science · Pandas (Software) · C# · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Computer Science · Applied Machine Learning

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Upgraded several peripherals from a netcore2 framework to .NET6.0 and .NET8.0.
Created Unit Tests in C# using XUnit and NSubstitute.
Wrote programs in WPF that serve as tools for the company (most notably a data scrubber).
positions.insights: Skills: Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · Software Development · C# · Computer Science
